pairs: Sed et hoc facies,
“But you shall also do this,
ut mihi in sacerdotio consecrentur.
so that they may be consecrated to me in the priesthood:
Tolle vitulum de armento,
Take a calf from the herd,
et arietes duos immaculatos,
and two immaculate rams,
panesque azymos,
and unleavened bread,
et crustulam absque fermento,
and a crust without leaven that has been sprinkled with oil,
quæ conspersa sit oleo,
likewise,
lagana quoque azyma oleo lita:
unleavened cakes smeared with oil.
de simila triticea cuncta facies.
You shall make them all from the same wheat flour.
Et posita in canistro offeres:
And, having placed them in baskets, you shall offer them,
vitulum autem et duos arietes.
along with the calf and the two rams.
Et Aaron
And you shall bring forward Aaron and his sons,
ac filios ejus applicabis ad ostium tabernaculi testimonii.
to the door of the tabernacle of the testimony.
Cumque laveris patrem cum filiis suis aqua,
And when you will have washed the father with his sons in water,
indues Aaron vestimentis suis,
you shall clothe Aaron in his vestments,
id est,
that is,
linea
with the linen,
et tunica,
and the tunic,
et superhumerali
and the ephod,
et rationali,
and the breastplate,
quod constringes balteo.
which you shall draw together with the wide belt.
Et pones tiaram in capite ejus,
And you shall place the headdress on his head
et laminam sanctam super tiaram,
and the holy plate upon the headdress.
et oleum unctionis fundes super caput ejus:
And you shall pour the oil of unction over his head. And so,
atque hoc ritu consecrabitur.
by this rite, he shall be consecrated.
Filios quoque illius applicabis,
Likewise, you shall bring forward his sons,
et indues tunicis lineis,
and you shall clothe them in the linen tunics,
cingesque balteo,
and wrap them with the wide belt:
Aaron scilicet et liberos ejus,
Aaron, certainly, as well as his sons.
et impones eis mitras:
And you shall impose headdresses upon them.
eruntque sacerdotes mihi religione perpetua.
And they shall be priests to me by a perpetual ordinance.
Postquam initiaveris manus eorum,
After you have initiated their hands,
applicabis et vitulum coram tabernaculo testimonii.
you shall bring forward also the calf, in the presence of the tabernacle of the testimony.
Imponentque Aaron et filii ejus manus super caput illius,
And Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands upon its head.
et mactabis eum in conspectu Domini,
And you shall sacrifice it in the sight of the Lord,
juxta ostium tabernaculi testimonii.
beside the door of the tabernacle of the testimony.
Sumptumque de sanguine vituli,
And taking some of the blood of the calf,
pones super cornua altaris digito tuo,
you shall place it upon the horns of the altar with your finger,
reliquum autem sanguinem fundes juxta basim ejus.
but the remainder of the blood you shall pour next to its base.
Sumes et adipem totum qui operit intestina,
And you shall take all the fat which covers its intestines,
et reticulum jecoris,
and the mesh of the liver,
ac duos renes,
as well as the two kidneys,
et adipem qui super eos est,
and the fat that is on them,
et offeres incensum super altare:
and you shall offer them as a burnt offering upon the altar.
carnes vero vituli et corium et fimum combures foris extra castra, eo quod pro peccato sit.
Yet truly, the flesh of the calf, and the hide and the dung, you shall burn outside, beyond the camp, because it is for sin.
Unum quoque arietem sumes,
Likewise,
super cujus caput ponent Aaron
you shall take one ram,
et filii ejus manus.
and upon its head Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands.
Quem cum mactaveris,
And when you will have sacrificed it,
tolles de sanguine ejus,
you shall take from its blood
et fundes circa altare.
and pour it around the altar.
Ipsum autem arietem secabis in frustra:
Then you shall cut the ram into pieces,
lotaque intestina ejus ac pedes,
and,
pones super concisas carnes,
having washed its intestines and feet,
et super caput illius.
you shall place these upon the cut-up flesh and upon its head.
Et offeres totum arietem in incensum super altare:
And you shall offer the entire ram as a burnt offering upon the altar.
oblatio est Domino,
It is an oblation to the Lord,
odor suavissimus victimæ Domini.
a most sweet odor of the victim of the Lord.
Tolles quoque arietem alterum,
Likewise,
super cujus caput Aaron
you shall take the other ram,
et filii ejus ponent manus.
upon whose head Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands.
Quem cum immolaveris,
And when you will have immolated it,
sumes de sanguine ejus,
you shall take of its blood,
et pones super extremum auriculæ dextræ Aaron et filiorum ejus,
and place it on the tip of the right ear of Aaron and his sons,
et super pollices manus eorum ac pedis dextri,
and on the thumbs and big toes of their right hand and right foot,
fundesque sanguinem super altare per circuitum.
and you shall pour the blood upon the altar, all around.
Cumque tuleris de sanguine qui est super altare,
And when you have taken from the blood that is on the altar,
et de oleo unctionis,
and from the oil of unction,
asperges Aaron et vestes ejus,
you shall sprinkle Aaron and his vestment,
filios et vestimenta eorum.
his sons and their vestments.
Consecratisque ipsis et vestibus,
And after they and their vestments have been consecrated,
tolles adipem de ariete,
you shall take the fat of the ram,
et caudam et arvinam, quæ operit vitalia,
and the rump, and the lard that covers the internal organs,
ac reticulum jecoris,
and the mesh of the liver,
et duos renes, atque adipem, qui super eos est,
and the two kidneys along with the fat that is on them,
armumque dextrum,
and the right shoulder,
eo quod sit aries consecrationis:
because it is the ram of consecration,
tortamque panis unius,
and one turn of bread,
crustulam conspersam oleo,
a crust sprinkled with oil,
laganum de canistro azymorum,
and a cake from the basket of unleavened bread,
quod positum est in conspectu Domini:
which was placed in the sight of the Lord.
ponesque omnia super manus Aaron
And you shall place all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons,
et filiorum ejus,
and you shall sanctify them,
et sanctificabis eos elevans coram Domino.
lifting them up in the sight of the Lord.
Suscipiesque universa de manibus eorum:
And you shall take all these things from their hands
et incendes super altare in holocaustum,
and burn them upon the altar as a holocaust,
odorem suavissimum in conspectu Domini,
as a most sweet odor in the sight of the Lord,
quia oblatio ejus est.
because it is his oblation.
Sumes quoque pectusculum de ariete,
Likewise, you shall take the chest of the ram,
quo initiatus est Aaron,
with which Aaron was initiated,
sanctificabisque illud elevatum coram Domino,
and you shall sanctify it, lifting it up in the sight of the Lord,
et cedet in partem tuam.
and it will fall to your share.
Sanctificabisque et pectusculum consecratum,
And you shall sanctify both the consecrated chest
et armum quem de ariete separasti,
and the shoulder that you separated from the ram,
quo initiatus est Aaron et filii ejus,
with which Aaron was initiated with his sons,
cedentque in partem Aaron et filiorum ejus jure perpetuo a filiis Israël:
and these will fall to the share of Aaron and his sons, as a perpetual oath by the sons of Israel.
quia primitiva sunt et initia de victimis eorum pacificis quæ offerunt Domino.
For these are the greatest and the first of their victims of peace, which they offer to the Lord.
Vestem autem sanctam,
But the holy vestment,
qua utetur Aaron,
which Aaron shall use,
habebunt filii ejus post eum,
his sons shall possess after him,
ut ungantur in ea,
so that they may be anointed in it
et consecrantur manus eorum.
and their hands may be consecrated.
Septem diebus utetur illa qui pontifex pro eo fuerit constitutus de filiis ejus,
For seven days,
et qui ingredietur tabernaculum testimonii ut ministret in sanctuario.
he who is high priest in his place and who enters the tabernacle of the testimony to minister in the Sanctuary shall use it.
Arietem autem consecrationis tolles,
But you shall take the ram of consecration
et coques carnes ejus in loco sancto:
and cook its flesh in the holy place.
quibus vescetur Aaron et filii ejus.
And Aaron and his sons shall feed on it.
Panes quoque,
Likewise,
qui sunt in canistro,
the loaves which are in the basket,
in vestibulo tabernaculi testimonii comedent,
they shall consume in the vestibule of the tabernacle of the testimony,
ut sit placabile sacrificium,
so that it may be an appeasing sacrifice,
et sanctificentur offerentium manus.
and so that the hands of those who offer may be sanctified.
Alienigena non vescetur ex eis,
A stranger shall not eat from these,
quia sancti sunt.
for they are holy.
Quod si remanserit de carnibus consecratis,
And what may remain until morning,
sive de panibus usque mane,
of the consecrated flesh or of the bread,
combures reliquias igni:
you shall burn these remnants with fire.
non comedentur,
These shall not be eaten,
quia sanctificata sunt.
because they have been sanctified.
Omnia,
All that I have instructed you concerning Aaron
quæ præcepi tibi,
and his sons,
facies super Aaron et filiis ejus.
you shall do.
Septem diebus consecrabis manus eorum:
For seven days shall you consecrate their hands,
et vitulum pro peccato offeres per singulos dies ad expiandum.
and you shall offer a calf for sin on each day, as an atonement.
Mundabisque altare cum immolaveris expiationis hostiam,
And you shall cleanse the altar when you will have immolated the victim of expiation,
et unges illud in sanctificationem.
and you shall anoint it for sanctification.
Septem diebus expiabis altare, et sanctificabis,
For seven days, you shall expiate and sanctify the altar,
et erit Sanctum sanctorum: omnis,
and it shall be the Holy of holies.
qui tetigerit illud, sanctificabitur.
All those who will touch it must be sanctified.
Hoc est quod facies in altari:
This is what you shall acquire for the altar:
agnos anniculos duos per singulos dies jugiter,
Two one-year-old lambs, each day continually,
unum agnum mane,
one lamb in the morning,
et alterum vespere,
and the other in the evening;
decimam partem similæ conspersæ oleo tuso,
for the one lamb, a tenth part of fine flour sprinkled with crushed oil,
quod habeat mensuram quartam partem hin,
which shall have the measure of the fourth part of a hin,
et vinum ad libandum ejusdem mensuræ in agno uno.
and wine for a libation, of the same measure;
Alterum vero agnum offeres ad vesperam juxta ritum matutinæ oblationis,
truly, the other lamb you shall offer in the evening, according to the ritual of the morning oblation,
et juxta ea quæ diximus,
and according to what we have said,
in odorem suavitatis:
as an odor of sweetness.
sacrificium est Domino,
It is a sacrifice to the Lord,
oblatione perpetua in generationes vestras,
by a perpetual oblation among your generations,
ad ostium tabernaculi testimonii coram Domino,
at the door of the tabernacle of the testimony before the Lord,
ubi constituam ut loquar ad te.
where I resolve to speak to you.
Ibique præcipiam filiis Israël,
And there I will instruct the sons of Israel,
et sanctificabitur altare in gloria mea.
and the altar shall be sanctified by my glory.
Sanctificabo et tabernaculum testimonii cum altari,
I will also sanctify the tabernacle of the testimony with the altar,
et Aaron cum filiis suis,
and Aaron with his sons,
ut sacerdotio fungantur mihi.
to exercise the priesthood for me.
Et habitabo in medio filiorum Israël,
And I will live in the midst of the sons of Israel,
eroque eis Deus,
and I will be their God.
et scient quia ego Dominus Deus eorum,
And they shall know that I am the Lord their God,
qui eduxi eos de terra Ægypti,
who led them away from the land of Egypt,
ut manerem inter illos,
so that I might dwell among them.
ego Dominus Deus ipsorum.
I am the Lord their God.”
